descriptionHtml:
Decision D13 · P2 · Daniela

Q5 / Q6: should 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' exist (TFA-92595 AC 8 asks for it; TFA-94700 AC 5 / UAT TC-24 allow no bulk delete), and if so, should each removed task write task_deleted? Today it writes none, so tasksDeleted undercounts (OAT-06/S26)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-24/S29

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S26 Mark Encounter Complete with pending tasks: Delete Pending Tasks & Complete / Keep Tasks & Mark Complete / Cancel — go back -> which rows (Hospital)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician with three note-ready Hospital charts, each with two open tasks (one fresh chart per row); T0 and the day's hospital rollup read at T0. Nursing Home has no pending-task choice: Mark Visit Complete completes at once (snf PostRoundTab.tsx:45-51), so this table is Hospital-only

When D1 chart 1: Mark Encounter Complete -> Delete Pending Tasks & Complete. D2 chart 2: Mark Encounter Complete -> Keep Tasks & Mark Complete. D3 chart 3: Mark Encounter Complete -> Cancel — go back

Then D1: note_marked_complete 1 and task_deleted 2 against chart 1. D2: note_marked_complete 1 and no task row. D3: no note_marked_complete, chart 3 still note-ready, rollup notesCompleted not moved by it. Rollup: notesCompleted +2, tasksDeleted +2

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-17 step 4 (all three choices) + OAT-06 Test 5/7 + TFA-94514 AC 2 ('task deleted' logged) / AC 4. D1 is judged against AC 2: code read predicts no task_deleted row (PostRoundTab.tsx:453-457 drops the pending tasks through markComplete without logTaskTap); whether the bulk delete should count as deletions is in Q6. D3 judged: Cancel logs nothing and changes nothing. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows; to be decided by Daniela.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S26

Tickets: TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Local QA stack only (main e02167f), a brand-new @roundai.test physician per test, synthetic charts deleted after the reads. No model: every ai/* action is refused at the Convex socket and none was sent; tripwire clean for the final run (16:43:28Z mark, 'no model call'). Rows are read with the local admin key (patientActivity / usage / surveys _recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor) before and after the steps; reading them through Vikram's dashboard on the UAT deployment is S23 / Q12. Seeded three note-ready Hospital charts (finished note, billing pre-computed), each with 'QA fin task one: repeat lactate' and 'QA fin task two: wound photo'; each opened on Pre-Round, then Post-Round > Mark Encounter Complete; the Pending Tasks dialog listed both tasks every time. Judged 10/11: checkpoints D1 / D2 / D3; D1 note_marked_complete = 1; D2 note_marked_complete = 1 and no task row; D3 'Cancel - go back' wrote nothing and chart 3 is still note-ready with both tasks open; rollup notesCompleted +2; no patient content in any row; no model call. FAILED (1 cell): D1 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' wrote 0 task_deleted rows (then: 2). The two tasks are gone from chart 1, but the only rows are pre_round_summary_opened and note_marked_complete: PostRoundTab.tsx:453-457 saves the done tasks through markComplete without logTaskTap, as the code read predicted; rollup tasksDeleted +0 (recorded). The case judges D1 against TFA-94514 AC 2; whether the bulk delete at completion should count as task deletions is open (OAT-06 Q6, TC-24 Q5): if Daniela rules it should not, this cell becomes a pass. Record-only: TC-17 step 4 behaviour (TFA-92595, in progress: todo) - D1 removed only chart 1's pending tasks, D2 kept both open; minutesFromPreRoundOpened 0 on both completions. This run also gives the record TC-24/S29 (c) asks for: the bulk delete writes no task row.

Product issue: Nothing looks wrong to the physician: 'Delete Pending Tasks & Complete' completes the encounter and removes the pending tasks. But the pilot analytics never record those deletions: no task_deleted row is written and pilotDailyRounding.tasksDeleted does not move, so the task-deletion numbers Vikram reads miss every task a physician clears at completion (TFA-94514 AC 2; open question Q6).

Evidence: 5 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: backend-read-admin. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
